items.title: John "Knocky" Parker Interview, 1963-08-28
items.q: we could do the same thing Crosby can do with his instruments

ctx.x: Do you think that these bands at that time were more nearly hillbilly or swing?

Well, not swing yet, because swing hasn't come up. Swing didn't come up until, oh, I guess 36 it was coming, and I joined them in 35, just about. Swing was just beginning to come in. You were, to take this business about swing, the only difference in swing and jazz is simply voicing and prearranged, somehow or other. We see jazz, so to speak, because it's all prearranged and voiced. Voicing, not collective improvisation. And when it becomes a collective improvisation, you're getting back then into jazz. But…
Were you using written arrangements at this time?
